verses.english: “Mendicants, dragons reproduce in these four ways.

verses.pali: Aṇḍajā nāgā, jalābujā nāgā, saṁsedajā nāgā, opapātikā nāgā.
verses.english: Dragons are born from an egg, from a womb, from moisture, or spontaneously.

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, aṇḍajehi nāgehi jalābujā ca saṁsedajā ca opapātikā ca nāgā paṇītatarā.
verses.english: Of these, dragons born from a womb, from moisture, or spontaneously are better than those born from an egg.

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, aṇḍajehi ca jalābujehi ca nāgehi saṁsedajā ca opapātikā ca nāgā paṇītatarā.
verses.english: Dragons born from moisture or spontaneously are better than those born from an egg or from a womb.

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, aṇḍajehi ca jalābujehi ca saṁsedajehi ca nāgehi opapātikā nāgā paṇītatarā.
verses.english: Dragons born spontaneously are better than those born from an egg, from a womb, or from moisture.
These are the four ways that dragons reproduce.”
